name: Cyclone Juggernaut
summary: Two-handed Cyclone on the Juggernaut shell. The axe and the budget armour are the damage and defence; the ascendancy supplies endurance charges, recovery and stun immunity. No required unique.

pros.text: Very tanky through armour, endurance charges and Juggernaut recovery.
No required unique; a rare two-handed axe is the damage slot.
Cyclone hits while moving, so clear and defence happen together.
Strong single-target once the axe and attack speed are online.
Endurance charges make the mitigation forgiving while learning fights.
A comfortable lab runner for the first two labyrinths.

cons.text: Melee range means you eat mechanics a ranged build can walk away from.
Attack speed is both damage and survival, so slow weapons feel bad.
Clear speed is slower than a bow or a minion build.
Cyclone locks your movement into the spin.
Mana is tight before leech and reduced cost are solved.
Resolute Technique gives up critical strikes entirely.

pantheon.note: Gruthkul reduces physical damage taken, which is most of what kills a melee build.

summary.text: Cyclone Juggernaut is a two-handed melee build that measures 275.1k at red maps and 554.8k at pinnacle. Armour, endurance charges and the ascendancy carry the defence; the rare axe carries the damage, and no unique is required.

leveling.text: Level with Cleave until Cyclone unlocks, then switch to the two-handed axe and keep spinning. The first checkpoint measures 425 life and 26 damage; the second measures 498. Enduring Cry and a mana flask cover the early sustain.

maps.text: At red maps the build measures 275.1k damage, 29960 effective life and 12193 physical max hit. Keep the axe current, cap elemental resistances, and use the filter to hide the rest.

bossing.text: Pinnacle measures 554.8k damage with 36413 effective life and 14011 physical max hit. Hold the spin through small hits, then move out of the telegraphed slams instead of trying to out-armour them.
